Before you answer this

Check Person Approved. If it is not ticked, this request should not exist and should not be acted on.

Interactive Process Due is a real date and somebody is waiting behind it who cannot see it.

Never ask for anything medical. Not to verify, not to process, not to be thorough. The system has nowhere to put an answer, and asking is the harm this was built to remove.

"More info" quietly kills requests. If you set it, say precisely what is needed and by when.

Two people often work one request. Keep the discussion in the feed below so the next person is not starting from nothing.
